FReader v46 Android transport patch

Upstream: flutter_epub_viewer 2.2.1 (BSD-3-Clause; see LICENSE).
The lib/ tree, LICENSE, README.md and pubspec.yaml are vendored from the published package.

Changed upstream files:
- lib/src/platform/epub_web_view_io.dart: Android WebViewAssetLoader uses HTTPS assets, with file cross-origin access disabled.
- lib/src/server/epub_book_server.dart: same-origin /books/<token>/ URL routing; assets bypass book routing.
- lib/src/epub_viewer.dart: await and report native bridge start errors.

Book chapters are read from disk on demand. No external document upload or local HTTP port on Android.
The app uses this package by path; upload this entire folder with pubspec.yaml.
Original upstream documentation is kept unchanged and may describe the upstream transport.
Original license and Epub.js licenses remain in the shipped tree/assets.

FReader v50 loading patch
- epubView.js: report initial chapter errors; recover an invalid saved CFI to
  the first section; notify the native reader if PlatformReady preceded the script.
- epub_viewer.dart: ignore duplicate ready messages so they cannot restart a book.
- epub_web_view_io.dart: retry the ready handshake on main-page load completion.
- Application EPUB validation now reads metadata lazily off the UI isolate and
  supports encoded package paths, unique case-insensitive paths and UTF-16 XML.

FReader v51 viewport and swipe patch
- swipe.html: use a top-aligned, bounded application viewport instead of the
  upstream demo's flex centering and 800px minimum body height.
- epubView.js: remove the unitless innerHeight assignment. At early Android
  startup, 0 became a persistent 0px viewer while positive values were ignored.
  Wait for a nonzero viewport stable over two animation frames before creating
  a rendition. Superseded loads are cancelled; a 15s limit reports a load error.
- Keep the host size responsive to rotation; no one-time inline pixel height.
- Use chapter-local swipe state and client coordinates; cancel multi-touch and
  cancelled gestures. Reset navigation wrappers when reusing the same WebView.
- Existing EPUB content, UI, native transport and licenses are unchanged.
